_comment: Reference values for rdkit-conformer-mmff (RDKit 2024.9.5, ETKDGv3 randomSeed=0xf00d, MMFF94, ibuprofen). Calibrated on x86_64.
_calibration_note: ETKDGv3 with fixed seed is deterministic for a given RDKit version/platform. 3 oracle runs must agree; tolerance = physical minimum resolution. Asset integrity: sha256 of target.smi pinned; verifier validates before identity/recompute checks (P2 convention).
